badge_description: Students demonstrate their ability to operate the laser cutter and complete the cutting workflow using Makerspace equipment. This badge recognizes applied skill in the laser cutting process.
institutional_context: Academic skill development at NJIT Makerspace
earning_criteria_text: Students must demonstrate their laser cutting skills through an in-person practical assessment. A Makerspace instructor observes as the student applies the machine settings, uses the software to prepare cut files, and operates the equipment safely. Students must perform all steps independently.
